decisions.reason: The existing message-53 MODIFY already records incorporation of the custom-fabricated stainless-steel render-style spout into the system design.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures both the custom stainless-steel construction and the requested rendering fidelity; the prior barista-facing orientation remains unchanged.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the client's request for appearance fidelity to the rendering.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout as an explicit exception to the otherwise off-the-shelf V1 sourcing policy.
The source message's separate placard-placement decision is already fully represented by the existing message-53 MODIFY.
Selecting a custom-fabricated spout does not change the requirement to deliver a basic wiring plan, and the client source does not establish a specific wiring-plan modification.
The custom spout selection and rendering-fidelity decision do not alter the existing splash-control target.
The client source selects the custom stainless-steel appearance of the spout but does not necessarily modify the existing valve, gravity-feed, flow-control, or button-actuation behavior.
Changing the spout's construction and appearance does not alter the existing leak-prevention requirements.
The source decision does not change the requirement that the dispensing fluid path be removable or easy to flush and clean.
The custom spout and placard decisions do not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the accepted bowl-size reference.
The source message does not change the established beige primary color or green accents.
